# Mary Stubbs

## Overview

- **Age:** Around twelve years old  <sub>[v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Origin:** Across the harbor from the Glen  <sub>[v5 c5 P33](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0033)</sub>
- **Role:** Child worker / hired helper  <sub>[v5 c5 P35](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0035), [v5 c5 P42](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0042)</sub>

## Appearance

Mary has a slender, sun-browned face with rosy cheeks and faint blue 'white eyes' bordered by thin black circles around the irises. She has flaxen hair that she wears in limp braids or crimped, and a pretty mouth with white, even teeth. When first found, she was barefoot, unhatted, and dressed in a threadbare tartan garment, but she was later seen wearing a fresh blue velvet cap with a scarlet rosette, a navy blue coat, stylish cloth-topped boots, and a squirrel fur muff lined with gathered red satin.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014), [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005)_

## Personality

Mary is lively, outspoken, and resilient despite a hard life of abuse and hard work. She has a gossipy nature and feels compelled to share local rumors, though she often holds cynical or inaccurate views regarding stepmothers, ministers' finances, and social matters. Unafraid to speak her mind, she can be somewhat vain and arrogant when wearing new clothes, but she is generally regarded as an invigorating and pleasant companion by her peers.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P28](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0028), [v5 c5 P40](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0040), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 c33 P1](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0001), [v5 c33 P5](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0005), [v5 c34 P32](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0032)_

## Traits

- Lively and quick-tongued  <sub>[v5 c5 P28](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0028)</sub>
- Gossipy  <sub>[v5 c33 P0](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0000), [v5 c33 P5](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0005)</sub>
- Resilient  <sub>[v5 c5 P40](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0040)</sub>
- Vain about her appearance  <sub>[v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005)</sub>

## Abilities

- Hard manual labor and potato planting  <sub>[v5 c5 P42](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0042)</sub>
- Sharp hearing  <sub>[v5 c33 P5](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- Escape abusive guardians and secure employment in Port Marlow  <sub>[v5 c5 P40](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0040), [v5 c5 P42](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0042)</sub>

## History

After discovering that her abusive guardian, Mrs. Grimble, intended to relocate and hand her over to an even harsher cousin near Port Marlow, Mary ran away from her home across the harbor. She hid in Mr. Taylor's old hayloft in the Glen without food from Thursday until Saturday morning, when the Ashdown children discovered her. They brought her to the manse kitchen to feed her, after which she shared her story with them on a gravestone in the churchyard. She subsequently spent time with local youths, including visiting Bess and Izzy Carrow at Hollowmere and telling ghost stories. Mary also spread village gossip to Grace and Ida Ashdown, including rumors about local stepmothers, Rupert's prank with an eel, and Clementine Ainslie's refusal of Mr. Ashdown's marriage proposal, which Ida later helped set right.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014), [v5 c5 P21](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0021), [v5 c5 P27](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0027), [v5 c5 P29](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0029), [v5 c5 P40](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0040), [v5 c5 P42](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0042), [v5 c18 P0](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0000), [v5 c33 P2](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0002), [v5 c33 P5](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0005), [v5 c33 P7](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0007), [v5 c33 P9](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0009), [v5 c34 P32](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0032)_

## Background by volume

- Worked for Mrs. Grimble across the harbor, where she was overworked, underfed, and frequently beaten  <sub>[v5 c5 P33](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0033), [v5 c5 P35](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0035), [v5 c5 P40](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0040)</sub>
- Saved seventy cents earned from planting potatoes for Mrs. John Crawford  <sub>[v5 c5 P42](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0042)</sub>
